description: This file defines the logging infrastructure for the OpenClaw project, including configuration, log handlers, and utility functions for managing log levels, labels, and metadata handling. It integrates with Apple's os.Logger and provides a multiplexed logging system with file logging support.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: Custom log handler that writes logs to the Apple OSLog framework with configurable metadata and log level mapping.

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: Custom log handler that writes logs to a file, including structured metadata, for persistent logging.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level from user defaults.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether file logging is enabled from user defaults.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level enum instance based on string stored in user defaults.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Provides a human-readable title for each log level.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the logging system if it hasn't been initialized.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Constructs a label string combining subsystem and category.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label string into subsystem and category components.
